description.text: I. Professional OverviewInternational Business Administration is an interdisciplinary major that takes the global economy as the background and integrates knowledge from multiple disciplines such as management, economics, international trade, and cross-cultural communication. The core lies in cultivating compound talents with an international perspective, cross-cultural management capabilities and global strategic thinking, enabling them to engage in international business operations, multinational team management, global market expansion and other work in scenarios such as multinational enterprises, international organizations and government agencies.This major emphasizes the integration of "internationalization" and "management practice". It not only requires students to master the basic theories of business administration (such as strategic management, marketing, financial management, etc.), but also needs to have a deep understanding of international business rules, cross-cultural management skills and global economic dynamics to cope with the complex international business environment.Ii. Core Curriculum Design1. Basic courses of Business AdministrationPrinciples of Management: Covering organizational behavior, leadership, decision-making theory, etc., laying the foundation for management thinking.Economics: including microeconomics, macroeconomics and international economics, it analyzes the laws governing the operation of the global economy.Marketing: Study international market research, brand management, and cross-border marketing strategies.Financial Management and Accounting: Master international financial analysis, financial management of multinational enterprises, and international accounting standards (such as IFRS).Operation management: It involves supply chain management, international logistics optimization, cross-border production planning, etc.

duration.text: The International Business Administration at Shenzhen University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 3611 USD/per year ￥ 26000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1.Scanned copy of high school certification and transcript. Recent graduates shall provide pre-graduation certificate which shows your expected graduation time and present the original high school certification, transcripts, and their translations when you register.2.Photo Copy of Passport Info Page3.Passport Photo4.Language Proficiency Certificate (The language proficiency certificate must be within the validity period)（1）Programs taught in Chinese(Excluding Chinese Language and Literature & Teaching Chinese to Speakers of Other Languages)：①A minimum score of 180 in HSK4 certification for Science and Engineering②A minimum score of 180 in HSK5 certification for Liberal Arts, Medicine, Arts（2）Programs taught in English：IELTS 5.5 / TOEFL IBT 80 / Duolingo 100 or above (Excluding English native speaker)5.Foreigner Physical Examination Form6.Resume (from primary school to now)7.Applicants for Guangdong Government Outstanding International Student Scholarship, please download the form, fill it out and upload it.8.Two Recommendation Letters(email, phone number and signature should be included.) and a Study Plan (around 500 words) should be provided if applying for Liyuan International Scholarship.In addition to the application materials detailed above, applicants should submit other supplementary materials required by SZU in time.Documents other than Chinese or English are required to be translated and notarized.Applicants who provide incomplete materials will not be accepted. The materials above won’t be returned whether you are admitted or not.

requirements.text: 1.Applicants must be Non-Chinese citizens with valid foreign passports and shall be 18-25 years old. He / She should be in good health conditions and of good conduct. He / She should also abide by the Chinese laws, regulations and the rules of the university.Applicants under the age of 18 by August 31th in the current year must provide the Power of Attorney as required.2.Applicants should be graduated from high school or above （Applicants who are still in the last year of high school can provide expected graduation certificate for submitting application while the official graduation certificate must be provided before enrollment）.3.Applicants should meet the corresponding language level requirements (The language proficiency certificate must be within the validity period).(1)Programs taught in Chinese：①A minimum score of 180 in HSK4 for Science and Engineering②A minimum score of 180 in HSK5 for Liberal Arts, Medicine, Arts③No HSK requirement for Chinese Language and Literature & Teaching Chinese to Speakers of Other Languages（TCSOL）(2)Programs taught in English：IELTS 5.5 / TOEFL IBT 80 / Duolingo 100 or above (Excluding English native speaker)Native speakers of Chinese or English can be exempted from the corresponding language proficiency certificate after being recognized by our university.
